nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Coordinate Descent enet_path Solver Dispatch Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic solver-dispatch helpers from sklearn.linear_model._coordinate_descent.enet_path around the compiled coordinate-descent solver family.

nodes.name: cd_enet_path_gram_validation_required
nodes.description: Return whether enet_path should validate a Gram matrix before Gram-solver dispatch.

nodes.name: cd_enet_path_use_sparse_solver
nodes.description: Return whether enet_path should dispatch to sparse_enet_coordinate_descent.

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether sparse solver dispatch should be used

nodes.name: cd_enet_path_use_multi_task_solver
nodes.description: Return whether enet_path should dispatch to the multitask solver.

inputs.name: use_sparse_solver
inputs.type_desc: whether sparse solver dispatch already matched

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether multitask solver dispatch should be used

nodes.name: cd_enet_path_use_gram_solver
nodes.description: Return whether enet_path should dispatch to enet_coordinate_descent_gram.
nodes.type_signature: (use_sparse_solver: bool, multi_output: bool, precompute_is_array: bool) -> bool

inputs.name: use_sparse_solver
inputs.type_desc: whether sparse solver dispatch already matched

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether Gram solver dispatch should be used

nodes.name: cd_enet_path_use_dense_solver
nodes.description: Return whether enet_path should dispatch to the dense enet solver.
nodes.type_signature: (use_sparse_solver: bool, use_multi_task_solver: bool, precompute_is_false: bool) -> bool

inputs.name: use_sparse_solver
inputs.type_desc: whether sparse solver dispatch already matched

inputs.name: use_multi_task_solver
inputs.type_desc: whether multitask solver dispatch already matched

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether dense solver dispatch should be used

nodes.name: cd_enet_path_invalid_precompute_message
nodes.description: Return the invalid-precompute ValueError text used by enet_path.
